lines.text: The cupboard door swung open. Mira stopped with a full shopping cart on her phone.
Mira and Asha are fictional. Mira had added toiletries to her Atomy shopping list.
On the shelf sat unused supplies. She had forgotten them. Buying more had been her idea.
She counted the bottles, crossed out the extras, and closed the cart without ordering.
Then she put one note on the fridge: Use what we have first. The cupboard finally won.
